title: Galatea & Hunting

s.x: runs a Starlyn Contest every SkyBlock day (20 minutes), so there's always one on. Everything you do on the Moonglade Marsh scores points:
Your points put you in a bracket: Common 25, Uncommon 100, Rare 400, Epic 1,000, Legendary 2,500, Mythic 5,000, Divine 8,000, Special 12,000.
